Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original woman in her mid-twenties wearing a deep-cobalt bikini. The casting is an original adult fashion model. She stands barefoot at a bright ocean waterline with her back toward the camera, her body remaining a clear rear view as she turns her head slightly toward the horizon. Frame her full figure from a low camera position behind her at knee height. Her legs stay close and softly adducted so the actual upper inner-thigh contours create a small patch of visible beach between them, producing a visible thigh gap with believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her long dark wavy hair, shoulders, and calves; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon complete the serene coastal setting. Keep the result polished and realistic, with natural proportions, authentic skin texture, and balanced emphasis on the overall swimwear silhouette and sunlit atmosphere.

obligation.composition_instruction: Establish a familiar physically coherent scene through clean photographic capture, select exactly one world invariant to fail, and include a clear normal control state against which the violation can be compared. Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces. Within every affected region, preserve the source surface's native material identity, local texture, thickness, lighting, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion while the chosen rule changes its coordinates or correspondence; the error must follow the three-dimensional scene rather than cut and move a flat image plane. Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary. Choose a deliberate reveal strength: either an immediate authored contradiction or a quiet second-look contradiction. In either mode, it must read as one integrated world system rather than a visible effect shell, portal, particle dissolve, or generic image failure.

render_gates.description: Lens, sensor, exposure, and image surface read as clean photographic capture rather than a damaged display or file.
The scene establishes an immediately familiar and physically coherent baseline before the contradiction is inspected.
Exactly one spatial, temporal, causal, optical, or topological invariant supplies the governing error rule.
At least three affected surfaces repeat the same measurable displacement, lag, dependency, correspondence, or recursion.

Within every affected region, native material identity, local texture, lighting, thickness, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion remain coherent under the shared rule; source pixels or facial texture are not stamped onto unrelated surfaces.
Unaffected anatomy, objects, perspective, lighting, and materials remain internally coherent and physically plausible.

The contradiction appears at the deliberately selected reveal strength, immediate or delayed, while remaining clearly authored, subordinate to one inferable world rule, and distinguishable from generic image failure.

A screen effect, split seam, collage, visible translucent shell, enclosing splash ring, portal, magical rift, flat image-plane slice, particle dissolve, or random anomaly stack does not substitute for the repeated world rule.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can state the single failed world rule and point to at least three separated instances that share its same measurable relation; merely saying that something looks wrong fails.
An isolated malformed hand or face, fused object, broken texture or text, accidental reflection or shadow mismatch, or other familiar synthesis defect does not carry the reality-error concept.
